title: Linear Probe Penalties Reduce LLM Sycophancy

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the model with contrasting user opinions (e.g., 'I really like' vs 'I really dislike' a poem) and calculating the feedback positivity gap to measure how frequently the model alters its responses to align with user sentiment.
Evaluating the distribution of the model's confidence scores in a movie review sentiment classification task to detect inherent preferences for selecting positive responses over negative ones.
Swapping the presentation order of multiple-choice options to observe if the model systematically favors the alternative presented last.

Altering the multiple-choice option identifiers (e.g., swapping 'A' and 'B', or changing them to 'P' and 'N') to identify and mitigate the model's arbitrary preference for specific label choices (e.g., a bias toward choosing 'B').
